rationale: stable_anchor_id assignment gives id-less siblings under the adapter strategy the same per-signature sibling index the content-hash strategy already uses, and pulp-import-design refuses a document whose anchors repeat (exit 2, naming each repeat). Anchors only identify nodes for bindings, tweaks and lock-to-source; no node, style, layout or paint changes, Chromium stays the only oracle and Skia/Dawn the renderer, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
